description.value: Sushi Jo is a Japanese restaurant in Courtenay, BC, helmed by a chef with over 25 years of experience in Japanese cuisine. The extensive menu spans sushi, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, teriyaki, and bento boxes crafted from fresh ingredients, alongside a full drinks menu featuring sake, Japanese beer, and cocktails. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down dining destination with a broad menu including multiple vegetarian-friendly dishes and a call-ahead takeout option.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard at 67m; rack (4 spaces) at 86m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and corroborates OSM phone and address. The menu page confirms vegetarian options (Vegetable Teriyaki, Tofu Teriyaki, Veggie Gyoza, Vegetable Box bento) and the homepage 'CALL TO PLACE AN ORDER' confirms takeout service. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those are marked null.
concerns: OSM address field omits the city name 'Courtenay'; website contact page confirms full address as '597 Cliffe Ave, Courtenay, BC'. Used website value for address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established sit-down Japanese restaurant with 25+ years of chef experience, confirmed takeout service, and vegetarian menu options — a solid Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists passing through Courtenay.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Vegetable Teriyaki, Tofu Teriyaki, Veggie Gyoza, Vegetable Box bento, Yam Tempura, Veggie Tempura, and various veggie appetizers and rolls

wow_evidence: chef with over 25 years of experience in Japanese cuisine
